purpose: Deterministic adversarial policy coverage; not FalkorDB Cloud execution.

scenarios.name: High-severity direct and shared-line exposure
scenarios.expected: Two direct lots and one uncleaned adjacent lot require action.

scenarios.name: Medium-severity adjacent exposure remains review-only
scenarios.expected: Direct lots require action; the adjacent lot is surfaced for review.

scenarios.name: Adjacent run outside the 60-minute policy window
scenarios.expected: The late adjacent lot is excluded.

scenarios.name: Unvalidated cleaning cannot stop propagation
scenarios.expected: Both adjacent runs inside the window remain exposed.

scenarios.name: Missing load-bearing lineage edge
scenarios.expected: No path means no proposed action.

scenarios.name: Approval gate and idempotent replay
scenarios.expected: Pre-approval execution is blocked; replay creates no duplicate effect.
